name: Witchcraft (Oracle Mystery)
body:
You are well-versed in the use of herbs to create healing balms, make poisons, brew teas, and concoct potions. Foresight, sisterhood, hexes, herbal lore, unity with nature, and awareness of spirits are the mainstays of your craft.

Class Skills: An oracle with the witchcraft mystery adds Handle Animal, Knowledge (arcana), Knowledge (nature), and Perception, to her list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: thorn javelin (2nd), sickening entanglement (4th), rain of frogs (6th), poison (8th), curse, major (10th), dispel magic, greater (12th), arcane sight, greater (14th), spellcrash, greater (16th), foresight (18th).

Revelations: An oracle with the witchcraft mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Boils (Su)

As a standard action, you can make a ranged touch attack against a creature within 30 feet to cover it with painful, oozing boils. On a successful hit, the target takes 1d4 points of damage +1 point for every two oracle levels you possess and 2 points of Charisma damage. On the round following the initial attack, the target must make a successful Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier) or take another 2 points of Charisma damage. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. At 11th level, the damage increases by 1d4 and the Charisma damage increases to 4 points on the first round.

Cauldron (Su)

You gain Brew Potion as a bonus feat. You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Control Vermin (Sp)

You can cast summon swarm, repel vermin, and phantasmal web once each per day as a spell-like ability. You must be at least 15th level to select this revelation.

Curse of the Necromancer: Your magic is heavily influenced by either the dark arts (which taps into necromancy to create phantasms and fear effects) or curse magic. When you select this revelation, you must choose either Curse Magic or Dark Arts. This choice is permanent and can’t be changed. Beginning when you select this revelation and every time you gain access to a new spell level thereafter, you can choose whether you add the standard witchcraft bonus spell or the bonus spell from your curse (or dark arts) list to be your bonus spell. Once you select one of the two options, the choice is final and can’t be changed. For example, if you’ve chosen curse magic for this revelation, you can choose either ill omen or thorn javelin as your 1st level bonus spell, either disfiguring touch or sickening entanglement as your 2nd level bonus spell, etc.

Curse Magic

Bonus Spells: ill omen (2nd), disfiguring touch (4th), blindness/deafness (6th), debilitating portent (8th), Old Salt’s curse (10th), geas/quest (12th), pox of rumors (14th), prediction of failure (16th), transmute blood to acid (18th).

Dark Arts

Bonus Spells: bane (2nd), pox pustules (4th), fungal infestation (6th), fear (8th), oneiric horror, greater (10th), banshee blast (12th), finger of death (14th), frightful aspect (16th), weird (18th).

Gaze of Fear (Su)

As a standard action, you can cause an enemy within 30-ft. of you to become paralyzed with fear. If the enemy fails its Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier), it cannot move or take any actions (including purely mental ones) and is considered helpless. This is a mind-affecting fear effect, and it lasts 1 round. You can use this ability once per day. At 7th level, and every four levels thereafter, this effect lasts for 1 additional round. You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Future Glimpses (Ex)

You can see moments into the future alerting you to threats moments before they occur. You gain Improved Initiative as a bonus feat, and once per day you can activate this ability as a swift action to gain a dodge bonus to your AC equal to your Charisma modifier for 1 minute.

Hedgewitch: You can select one revelation from the Nature mystery that does not deal damage.

Poison Knowledge (Ex)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saves against poisons, and you are trained in the use of poison and cannot accidentally poison yourself when applying poison to a weapon. At 11th level, choose one of the following poisons: arsenic, bloodroot, hemlock, terinav root. This choice is permanent and can’t be changed. Each day when you prepare your mind to cast spells, you can spend 10 minutes creating 1 dose of your selected poison. The poison remains active for 24 hours.

Wind Ward (Ex)

As an immediate action, you surround yourself with gusts of localized wind that grants you a +4 armor bonus. At 7th level, and every four levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +2. At 13th level, this barrier causes incoming arrows, rays, and other ranged attacks requiring an attack roll against you to have a 50% miss chance. You can use this barrier for 10 minutes per day per oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 10-minute increments.

Witch’s Hex (Su)

Select one of the following witch’s hexes: misfortune, slumber, summer’s heat, unnerve beasts, or ward. This choice is permanent and can’t be changed. A hex requires a standard action to use and all references to Intelligence are changed to Charisma instead.

The saving throw DC against any hex equals 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier.

You can use the selected hex 3 times per day.

Final Revelation

Upon reaching 20th level, you have formed a deep bond of sisterhood with your traveling companions who have become your coven. Whenever an ally is within 10 feet of you, the DC to resist any spell that you cast is increased by +1. Furthermore, whenever you deal poison damage from a spell, the damage is doubled.

Amazons vs Valkyries: Cult of Hecate, © 2023, Bloodstone Press; Author P. C. Graves and Beth Jones
